record_type_quote: In this replication, we recruited participants to complete the study from MTurk.

targets.authors: Fernbach, P. M., Kan, C., & Lynch Jr, J. G.
targets.title: Squeezed: Coping with constraint through efficiency and prioritization.
targets.evidence_quote:
For our replication project we were mainly interested in the plan type analysis presented in the
main paper. However, Fernbach et al. also conducted a timing analysis, which is largely reported
in Appendix E of their original paper. Therefore, we also attempted to replicate the timing
analysis.
targets.outcome_quote:
The omnibus interaction effect was not significant, F(2, 297) = 1.96,
p = .143. The single df contrast testing for the linear effect of constraint by the type of plan was
also not significant, F(1, 297) = 1.44, p = .23 but was directionally consistent the original finding
t(297) = 1.20.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The central constraint-by-plan-type effect and additional timing interaction were nonsignificant. Directional agreement is acknowledged, but the predicted central interaction was not supported; no overall author verdict is stated.
